title: Princess Pink Clipart
author: AMBillustrations
description:
9 Cliparts of Princesses all dressed in pink! With 3 blonds, 3 redheads and 3 brunettes perfect for all your invitations, cards or parties! Great for girl birthday parties, scrapbooking, girls bedrooms and more.
All the clipart and designs are original and high quality.
You will receive the follow graphic elements
– Each clipart saved separately in 6” x 6” 300 dpi PNG files, transparent background.- Each clipart saved separately in 6” x 6” 300 dpi JPEG files, white background.
– 1 EPS file.
